scenes.heading: BEATS VEO 3 — FREE
scenes.say: Who is beating Veo 3 — and letting you generate for free?
There is a leaderboard where people vote on AI videos without knowing which model made them. ByteDance's Seedance sits on top — above Veo three and Sora two.
The output is two-K, runs up to fifteen seconds a clip, and talking heads get proper lip sync — the thing most video models still fumble.
Here is the part the title means: it is free inside CapCut right now. No credit card for a start. If you build on it, the API is fourteen cents per clip.

nodes: Artificial Analysis is the independent one

youtube.title: Seedance 2.0 Beats Veo 3 And It's Free
youtube.description: Seedance 2.0 tops the independent Artificial Analysis Video Arena leaderboard for text-to-video (Elo ~1,269; Veo 3 is ~1,226) — blind human voting, not vendor numbers. It makes 2K, 15-second clips with the best lip sync in hands-on reviews, and it is free inside CapCut today (ByteDance's own editor). API runs about $0.14 per 15-second clip. Catch: access outside China is spotty and ByteDance's own benchmark is self-reported — trust only the independent board. #Shorts
